author: SlabSun
body:
IGN: Warbry
Reason: Being mean/swearing when killed alot, and combat logging for the past 3 months. I have also lied to others when they asked if I Combat logged by saying "I keep timing out/My internet sucks"
I want to stop this bad habit and addiction to this server as I have lost many nights of sleep and may ruin my future. 
Evidence Ask CaptainMcPie I have logged infront of him, due to rage. And I know I have been doing it. I even did it today

Suggestion: I want 1 year worth of ban length, so I can focus on my own life and have time to rid myself of bad habits.

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
We don't ban on request. If you combat log so much and are rude, you should stop; just be a good noodle.

Regarding focusing on your life, self-control is rather important. I recommend uninstalling Minecraft, cutting away from the computer, or anything in regards of retiring Avicus if it's what you wish to do. Anyway, I'll lock this thread. You will not be punished but this is to say if you are caught, you will be punished. Thanks.
